title: enable_tracing must be passed into Vertex AI delegates or passthrough span usage is lost
answers: token usage missing from trace span for Vertex AI Claude streaming passthrough
AI Gateway tracing shows no usage attribute for Vertex Claude
gateway span has no token counts for Vertex AI model
body:
Symptom: a streaming passthrough request to a Vertex AI Claude model completes but its trace span has no token usage attribute.
Root cause: the delegate's streaming path accumulates usage on itself, and _set_span_token_usage is a no-op when the delegate's own _enable_tracing is False. VertexAIProvider.__init__ built the delegates without enable_tracing.
Fix pattern: accept enable_tracing in _VertexAIClaudeProvider.__init__ and _VertexAIMaaSProvider.__init__, pass it to BaseProvider.__init__, and forward the outer provider's flag when constructing the delegate.
Constraints: non-streaming usage is read via the delegate's _extract_passthrough_token_usage for the same reason, because the Gemini extractor returns nothing for an Anthropic response. Any new delegate must take and forward the flag. Covered by test_delegate_inherits_enable_tracing.
applies: Constructing or adding delegates in VertexAIProvider, and any change to span usage recording for Vertex passthrough.
says: Streaming responses from Claude models on Vertex AI are missing token usage statistics.
Trace details in the AI Gateway dashboard do not show token counts for streaming.
Model trace spans should accurately record consumed tokens for all streamed gateway requests.
Gateway usage monitoring fails to display token metrics after streaming completions.
search: VertexAIProvider must forward enable_tracing when instantiating _VertexAIClaudeProvider and _VertexAIMaaSProvider delegates so streaming trace spans capture token usage attributes. The delegate constructors in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py must accept enable_tracing and forward it to BaseProvider.__init__. Any new delegate must follow this pattern because _set_span_token_usage requires the flag to record usage and the Gemini extractor cannot parse Anthropic responses.
